purpose: Plain-language translation layer for public soil story cards.
important_limit: These rules translate mapped soil properties into habitat interpretations. They do not confirm exact microbes at a property.

soil_personalities.label: Sticky Sponge
soil_personalities.trigger: clay >= 35% or mapped name/texture contains clay
soil_personalities.plain_meaning: Clayey soil can hold water and nutrients, but it can compact and become hard when dry.

soil_personalities.label: Limestone Lunchbox
soil_personalities.trigger: pH >= 7.4, CaCO3 >= 5%, or mapped name suggests limestone/carbonate influence
soil_personalities.plain_meaning: Nutrients may be present, but high pH can keep some of them chemically locked up.
actions: Use soil tests before adding fertilizer

soil_personalities.label: Thin-Skin Hill Soil
soil_personalities.trigger: restriction depth <= 50 cm, shallow/rock/lithic wording, or high rock signal
soil_personalities.plain_meaning: Thin soil over rock dries quickly and gives roots less room.

soil_personalities.label: Flood-Pulse Soil
soil_personalities.trigger: poor drainage, hydric/flood/pond/riparian wording, or wet lowland context
soil_personalities.plain_meaning: Wet periods can lower oxygen and change nutrient cycling.

soil_personalities.label: Root-Fed Prairie Soil
soil_personalities.trigger: ecological site or plant indicators include prairie, grassland, bluestem, grama, Indiangrass, switchgrass, gamagrass, or perennial forbs
soil_personalities.plain_meaning: Grassland roots feed the soil food web and help build structure.
actions: Use diverse native grasses and forbs

soil_personalities.label: Leaf-Litter Woodland Soil
soil_personalities.trigger: ecological site or indicators include oak, woodland, forest, savanna, trees, or woody species
soil_personalities.plain_meaning: Woody roots and leaf litter can support fungal decomposition and tree-root soil processes.

microbe_job_groups.label: Recyclers
microbe_job_groups.plain_meaning: Break down dead leaves, roots, mulch, and compost.

microbe_job_groups.label: Nutrient unlockers
microbe_job_groups.plain_meaning: Help move nitrogen, phosphorus, sulfur, iron, and minerals into more usable forms.

microbe_job_groups.label: Root helpers
microbe_job_groups.plain_meaning: Live near roots and support nutrient exchange and root-zone structure.

microbe_job_groups.label: Soil builders
microbe_job_groups.plain_meaning: Help glue soil into crumbs so air and water can move.

microbe_job_groups.label: Drought survivors
microbe_job_groups.plain_meaning: Persist through heat, drying, and wet-dry swings.

microbe_job_groups.label: Balance keepers
microbe_job_groups.plain_meaning: Shift with water, oxygen, pH, clay, roots, and organic matter.

evidence_labels.needs_test: Needs local test for exact confirmation
